findings.problem: The proposed parser recognizes only the exact host `arxiv.org`. This leaves valid `www.arxiv.org/abs/...` and `www.arxiv.org/pdf/...` candidates to the ordinary page capture, contrary to criterion 2's requirement that an arXiv-paper address from another source be captured as a preprint. It also conflicts with the existing canonical identity support, which recognizes `www.arxiv.org` as an arXiv host.
findings.suggestion: Define the supported arXiv host set consistently with the existing identity logic (at least `arxiv.org` and `www.arxiv.org`), route and test each supported host through `capture_arxiv.capture`, or explicitly narrow the completion criterion and spec to apex-host addresses only.

findings.problem: Test 2(h) requires any non-paper address on `arxiv.org` to be rejected without a call, but implementation step 4 only rejects a no-id address when its candidate source is `arxiv`. A non-arXiv-source candidate at `/list/cs/new` will fall through to `capture_url.capture`, so the listed test and implementation steps do not describe the same behavior.
findings.suggestion: Choose the intended rule and state it in step 4: either reject every candidate on the supported arXiv hosts whose path is not a paper address, with tests across sources, or limit test 2(h) to `source=arxiv` and retain ordinary page capture for other sources.

summary: The duplicate and legacy-ID issues from round 1 are addressed, but host coverage and the non-paper-address rule remain internally incomplete.
